mechanism_narrative: High federal funds rates indicate tighter monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces consumer and business spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in >50% of instances when FEDFUNDS >4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate signals a strong labor market and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly higher during low unemployment periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Increasing real sales indicate strong consumer demand, which positively impacts corporate earnings and drives S&P 500 returns higher over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Rapid industrial production growth signals economic expansion, leading to increased corporate productivity and higher S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not higher during periods of industrial production growth.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing housing starts indicate strong demand in the housing market, which positively impacts related industries and leads to higher S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns do not show a significant increase following housing starts growth.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment combined with increasing payroll employment indicates a strong labor market, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not higher when both conditions are met (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth indicates a robust economy, leading to increased corporate earnings and higher S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, high inflation (CPI) leads to increased interest rates, reducing corporate profitability and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive despite high inflation and rising FEDFUNDS.
